title: Tips to Increase Your Chances & Application Best Practices
eligibility: All applicants
content:
Tips to Increase Your Chances of Selection (Pages 5, 28):
1. Write a project-specific SOP (Statement of Purpose), not a generic one. Tailor it to the professor's recent publications.
2. Shortlist faculty before applying — read their research interests and reach out or align your application with active lab projects.
3. Apply early — some portals close very fast once application volume peaks.
4. Keep CV, semester mark sheets, and No Objection Certificate (NOC) from your college ready in advance.
5. Safety & Verification: Always confirm official institute domains (.ac.in or .gov.in). Never pay any money or UPI transfer to 'secure' an internship. Genuine internships never ask for fees to hire you.
6. Request written confirmation of stipend, faculty supervisor, work location, and certificate policy.

title: Branch-wise Internship Search Checklist & Opportunities
eligibility: All engineering and science students
content:
Branch-wise Search Checklist (Page 28):
- Computer Science / IT / AI / Data: Software engineering, AI/ML, data science, cybersecurity, cloud, systems, research labs, NIC, C-DAC, and university faculty projects.
- ECE / EEE / VLSI / Embedded: Semiconductor firms, telecom, electronics R&D, power utilities, automation firms, DRDO/ISRO project calls, and IIT/IISc labs.
- Mechanical / Automobile / Production / Mechatronics: OEMs, manufacturing plants, robotics, energy, industrial R&D, and mechanical research institutes (CMERI, DRDO, Tata Motors, Maruti).
- Civil / Architecture / Planning / Geomatics: Infrastructure firms, structural labs, CBRI, water resources, transport, GIS/remote sensing, and architecture studios.
- Chemical / Petroleum / Polymer / Materials / Metallurgy / Mining: Process industries, refineries, steel, polymers, CSIR labs, materials labs, and geology/mining research units.
- Biotechnology / Biomedical / Pharmacy / Food / Agriculture: Biotech and pharma R&D, hospitals/health technology firms, ICMR/ICAR institutes, food labs, and life-science research centres.
- Environmental / Energy / Renewable / Ocean / Earth Sciences: Environmental labs, renewable energy companies, NIH, NIOT, IIRS, GSI, CSIR-NEERI, and faculty projects.
- Science, Mathematics, Economics, Design, and Interdisciplinary: IISERs, TIFR, IISc, IIT research projects, design labs, UX/product internships, and incubated startups.
